segment: Model lab - world models / physical AI
what_they_do: Started in August 2026 by former Google DeepMind world-model researchers (the team behind Genie). Builds AI world models that simulate physical environments, for robotics and simulation.

signals.signal: Reported closing a seed round of up to $700M at about a $3.5-3.7B valuation, led by Index Ventures and Lightspeed, about one month after incorporation
Founded Aug 2026 by Jack Parker-Holder (a principal researcher on Genie 3), Matthew McGill and Philip Ball; in advanced talks on the $700M round
Round coverage: DeepMind spinout nears $700M seed at $3.7B valuation

est_gpu_need: 2,000-4,000+ H100-equiv (4-10 MW), mostly pretraining with some real-time inference. World models (Genie-class interactive video/3D) are among the most compute-hungry workloads. A $700M seed with no product means most of the money will go on compute, and the company has no installed base yet.
timing_rationale: The company is weeks old, newly funded, and has no clusters of its own. It has to secure training capacity for a first model in H1 2027, so supplier selection is happening in Q4 2026. Raion's Nov 2026 go-live with 0.5 MW block scaling matches a staged ramp in Feb-Apr 2027, and a UK-hosted, isolated cluster fits a UK-founded lab with Index as lead investor.

est_gpu_need: 256-2,000 H100-equiv. The 500k GPU-hour Isambard grant is reported as roughly two orders of magnitude below a true frontier run, so continued training needs more capacity. Serving a ~1T-parameter MoE to regulated banks and defence primes needs dedicated, UK-resident inference.
timing_rationale: Lumen Sovereign is due to deploy at the end of 2026. Production inference for coalition members (banks, defence) would ramp in Q1 2027, and the next funding round is expected. Raion's British-law SPV and isolated clusters match the 'no foreign infrastructure' positioning almost exactly. The coalition also opens warm introductions to Lloyds, NatWest, BT, BAE and others.
